_doc: The asset seam: the ONLY place a visual ID maps to a file. Each entry is {"path": real art, "placeholder": stand-in}, plus any fields the consumer needs. See PLAN.md 5.3.

vis.tiles.material_atlas._doc: One seamless cell per tile type, plus thruster nozzles tinted by type. R = detail, G = untinted trim (PLAN.md 6.2). Real art: A.1.

vis.fx.thrusters._doc: Thruster exhaust (PLAN.md 3.6), drawn in code with particles; no files. level_scale multiplies the size per level (L1-3). Colours run hot core -> fading edge.

vis.weapons._doc: Guns (PLAN.md 4.4), drawn in code until their art lands; no files. A turret is a round base with a barrel, an edge gun a mounting block with one. Sizes in U. The hangar marks each gun's mode with a dot: manual or auto.

vis.fx.projectiles._doc: Shots in flight (Phase 4.3), drawn as additive tracer streaks in one MultiMesh; no files. Per weapon id, else default. length_u and width_u are the streak's size.

vis.fx.explosion._doc: A ship's death (PLAN.md 4.2), drawn in code; no files. A white flash, an expanding ring and a burst of sparks (fireballs), sized by the ship: spark_size is [min, max] as a share of the ship's length. Colours run hot -> cooling.
